sat_and_act_policies.clarification_for_test_policy: Washington University in St. Louis has adopted a test-optional policy. All applicants, whether or not they submit standardized testing, will receive full consideration for admission. Please visit admissions.washu.edu to learn more about our testing policy and ongoing updates. International applicants whose first language is not English are required to submit results from an English Language proficiency exam (TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo English Test). Waivers are available based upon educational background, other standardized testing results, or exceptional circumstances. Full details of our international testing policy are available on our website.
